Load Open Targets data, selecting to include ranked genes with genetic associations to Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) (MONDO_0002009).

# Load gene list

Load libraries.
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
```

Load data.
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
data <- read_tsv("data/OpenTargets/OT-MONDO_0002009-associated-targets-9_15_2026-v26_06_weights_genetics_only_MDD.tsv")
```


# Filter gene list

Select data columns and subset.
```{r}
# Here, gene names, Open Targets association scores, and  all columns containing genetic association scores from different databases
columns_genetic <- colnames(data[1:12])
columns_genetic
data_sub <- subset(data, select = columns_genetic)
```


Remove rows containing 'No data' for genetic associations
```{r}
# Define the columns to check, here all columns containing genetic association scores from different databases
columns_to_check <- colnames(data_sub[4:12])

# Filter the data frame
data_sub_filtered <- data_sub %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(columns_to_check), ~ .x == "No data"))

head(data_sub_filtered)
```

# Save gene list

Save the ranked gene set. Ranking is based on the Open Targets globalScore.
```{r, eval=T}
ranked_gene_set <- data_sub_filtered$symbol

write.table(ranked_gene_set, file = "data/OpenTargets/ranked_gene_sets/OT-MONDO_0002009-associated-targets-9_15_2026-v26_06_weights_genetics_only_MDD_ranked.csv", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, sep = ",")
```
